content.short: SCSVS is a list of standards that ensure smart contract security.
content.description: Founders of Composable Security, Paweł Kuryłowicz and Damian Rusinek, authored the Smart Contract Security Verification Standard (SCSVS) to help developers, architects, and analysts build and enforce security standards. Analysts can use the SCSVS to identify vulnerabilities in smart contracts, and developers can use it as a guide when building contracts from scratch.
